name: Admiring Woman
text: Whenever your team wins a trick with a heart, gain +10 contract value.
timing: When you win any trick (or your partner does)

signature.trigger: you or your partner win a trick with a heart

decision: Which hearts to cash and which to pass to your partner, since a heart win from either seat pays.
opponent: Visible on trigger; opponents answer by overtaking the partner's card or leading suits where you can't follow with a heart.
aiNote: Lead hearts once the opponents' high hearts are gone, and pass hearts to a partner who is long in them.
rationale: A Heart Chorus team wins two or three heart tricks a round between both seats, about +20 to +30, about +20 EV; counting both seats makes it easy to trigger and rewards passing hearts across the table, and it differs from Sunset Sailboat (TE-U05, your own late heart wins).
deviation: Simplified from partner wins you played a heart to, which was fiddly and hard to trigger.
